meta.off_atom_label: learned d1/d2 >= 1/3 at the last cutoff 1-T = 1e-4 (endpoint)
meta.score: e_learned(t) = (1-t)|Delta(Z_t,t)| = |m_hat(Z_t) - m*(Z_t)| along the learned RK4 path

bootstrap.cluster: 48 conditions resampled with replacement within each run; trained networks fixed (primary)
bootstrap.iid: samples (sources) resampled with replacement within each run, ignoring conditions
bootstrap.hier: seeds resampled with replacement, then conditions within each drawn seed (3 seeds: crude)

meta.ci: percentile 95% intervals; seed t-intervals use t(0.975, df=2) = 4.303

endpoint_information.note: every AUC, TPR and FPR is computed against it; unavoidable for evaluation

endpoint_information.statistic: final scaled error e(t = 0.9999) and its AUC (0.985 / 0.977)
endpoint_information.note: equals the endpoint's d1 within 0.2% for every sample; the label is d1/d2, so this AUC is the AUC of the label's numerator (bookkeeping, as the paper says)

endpoint_information.endpoint_info: yes, and the threshold was chosen in sample

endpoint_information.statistic: e_learned(t) for grid t < 1 and its AUC

endpoint_information.statistic: e_exact(t) (network error on the exact path) and its AUC
endpoint_information.note: needs the exact trajectory from the same source, integrated separately; no learned-endpoint information

endpoint_information.statistic: thresholds selected on other runs (h4->h6, h6->h4, leave-one-seed-out)
endpoint_information.endpoint_info: labels of the training runs only
endpoint_information.note: out of sample for the test runs; h4->h6 and h6->h4 share conditions and sources seed by seed, leave-one-seed-out at both h does not

endpoint_information.endpoint_info: score at t only; label yes; t selected post hoc
endpoint_information.note: the selection over t is made on the evaluated data; the bootstrap CI repeats the selection in every replicate

endpoint_information.statistic: condition-prior baseline (share of the other 15 sources of the condition that end off-atom)
